name: @researchos/ui-research-dashboard
description: Phase 4 ui-research-dashboard (v0.1): out-of-tree client package — a conversation chat node triggered by a user message keyword (dashboard / 仪表盘 / 统计) that renders a self-fetching statistics panel over the research bundles (projects, paper counts, plan). Validates the user-message-trigger pattern for non-tool pages.
